fusions.name: Gone Before It Stings
fusions.desc: A quick jab that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Lowered Rack
fusions.desc: Looses 4 antler tines in a spread, each dealing 9 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: On Tenterhooks
fusions.desc: You spring 2 tiles from where you stood, and your dodge chance rises by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Level Tines Running
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for your next strike. Once every 12 seconds.
